affected.note: Up to 11,483 people's data in 1,698 application documents from businesses applying to a Japan Tourism Agency subsidy program. Accessible to other selected businesses between 2022-05-24 and 2022-09-29; 18 businesses downloaded files and deleted them on request.

summary.en: JTB, which ran a Japan Tourism Agency subsidy program, failed to set file-level access rights on a cloud sharing tool, so applicants could see other applicants' documents. Personal data of up to 11,483 people was leaked, and some businesses downloaded the files.
summary.ja: 観光庁の補助事業者として事業を運営していたJTBは、情報共有用のクラウドサービスで個別のアクセス権限を設定しておらず、他社の申請書類を閲覧できる状態だった。最大1万1,483人分の個人情報が漏えいし、一部の事業者がファイルをダウンロードしていた。
